_comment: Merged key by key over the base game's makes.json and cars.json (docs/modding.md, "cars"). Abarth is a make of
its own in Fiat's family; Fiat and Alfa Romeo get a family (the base game gives them none), so their cars and
engines go together; Ford of Britain is a make apart from the American Ford, so an Escort never turns up with a
V8 out of a Mustang. The cars are Kunos cars every Assetto Corsa has, each with its engine build and layout.
